messages.subject: plugin packages for R 4.0
messages.body_plain:
hi,

i'm happy to announce that all plugin packages for RKWard have finally been 
rebuilt for R 4.0. windows and mac users should find these extra packages now 
in RKWard's package management dialog:

  rk.ANOVA
  rk.ClusterAnalysis
  rk.CohenKappa
  rk.FactorAnalysis
  rk.gitInstall
  rk.MultidimensionalScaling

GNU/linux users of debian/ubuntu based distributions can use the new 
repository:

  deb https://distribute.kde.org/rkward/debR40 unstable main

you should perhaps first install the PGP key used for signing manually:
https://distribute.kde.org/rkward/debR40/dists/unstable/main/all/rkward-keyring_0.01-1_all.deb

after "apt update" you should be able to install these plugin packages:

  r-other-rkward-rk.anova
  r-other-rkward-rk.clusteranalysis
  r-other-rkward-rk.cohenkappa
  r-other-rkward-rk.factoranalysis
  r-other-rkward-rk.gitinstall
  r-other-rkward-rk.multidimensionalscaling


viele grüße :: m.eik

-- 
  dipl. psych. meik michalke
  institut f"ur experimentelle psychologie
  abt. f"ur diagnostik und differentielle psychologie
  heinrich-heine-universit"at d-40204 d"usseldorf
